text:
jess: kicking off a cascade rollout for v3.2.0 — regional order US -> EU -> APAC. Canary in each region 5m, then ramp 20% -> 50% over 30m. Change window Tue 23:00 UTC. Need capacity green across regions and final pin for model v3.2.0-opt. @marcus can you confirm GPU warm pools?

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: v3.2.0-canary -> us-east-1. deploy-id: deploy-4512345678. canary health check in 5m.

sam: us-east warm pool check: idle GPUs 12/16, p99 latency 78ms, queue depth within threshold. smoke tests queued. recommending proceed for US canary.

marcus: noted. EU warm pool currently 6/16 idle. node-gpu-12 showing elevated thermals (platform alert earlier). ops will pre-shift non-critical workloads if EU canary ramps. holding APAC start until EU passes canary.

ana: pinned routing to v3.2.0-opt for canary traffic slices in US. release-notes draft: https://internal/release/3.2.0 (short link). added changelog snippet for batching/kv-cache improvements.

ops-bot: capacity alerts suppressed for canary window per rollout policy. monitoring links: https://monitoring/canary/4512345678.

jess: plan: if after 5m p99 < 120ms and error rate < 0.3% proceed to EU. Rollback policy: immediate pin-back to v3.1.9 if error spike > 1% sustained for 2m. Note: keep deploybot on manual hold for APAC until EU stable.

sam: US canary smoke run complete. p50 29ms, p95 58ms, p99 90ms. no increase in 5xx. US looks good, approving EU start. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: starting canary in eu-west-1. deploy-id: deploy-4512345695. canary health check in 5m.

marcus: EU canary started. watching thermal metric and GPU util. applying +10% headroom on queue throttle to avoid burst. tagging on-call.

ana: prepping APAC artifacts: prefetching model binaries and quant params to edge caches, warmup plan shows APAC warm pool ready in ~12m. will pin routing once we hit EU acceptance criteria.

jess: timeline update: EU canary 5m -> if good ramp APAC 15m after EU ramp start. tagging @marcus @sam for 30m post-cut watch.

marcus: quick rollback helper: `./ops/rollpin --region eu --to v3.1.9` (run from ci-ops, requires 2fa).

sam: adding perf sniffers for canary slice: `curl https://internal/metrics?slice=canary&region=eu` — will stream p50/p95/p99.

ops-bot: EU canary 5m check: no regressions detected, error-rate 0.12%, p99 110ms. continuing ramp to 20%. :tada:

jess: awesome — proceed with APAC warm and schedule ramp when warm pool ready. I'll post final release notes and the post-rollout checklist after APAC finishes. leaving this thread open for 30m post-cut for any rollback signals. :white_check_mark:

sam: noted. pushing a short runbook to the channel: `ops/rollbook/v3.2.0` — includes quick diagnostics and rollback steps.

marcus: on-call watch active. will shout if thermal or queue anomalies > threshold.

deploy-bot: final stage queued for ap-southeast-1 once warm pool reports ready.

ops-bot: warm pool ready in APAC in ~10m, prefetch success.

jess: thanks team. I'll update the release-notes and put a post-mortem template in case we need it.

marcus: good job all.

(ops-bot pinned this thread for 30m post-cut)
